altText: Taylor Swift in a sequined red top and black shorts performing 'I Knew You Were Trouble' in the Red set of the Eras Tour, Inglewood 2023, with pink smoke behind her.
body:
a winter romance right in the middle of the Red era, and i cannot get over how short it was ❤️

the Harry Styles chapter of our Blank Spaces timeline starts in early december 2012, when they were first photographed together, and ends on january 7, 2013, the day the breakup was reported during a trip to the British Virgin Islands.

Red had come out on october 22, only weeks before. and this is how i picture the Red era now: sequins and pink smoke in the Red set of the Eras Tour, Inglewood 2023.

critique.rationale: Leads with the feeling of a winter romance inside the Red era, then the lens dates and the Red release. The Eras Tour Red-set photo ties the chapter to the era it lived in, with a real credited shot of Taylor.
